visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long reddish-brown hair is sitting in a brightly lit room with white walls, speaking directly to the camera while wearing a dark grey sweatshirt. She holds a piece of grey fabric and gestures with her hands while smiling warmly. (2) The scene cuts to a bedroom where she is seen in a mirror wearing a grey sleeveless dress with a large bow detail; she uses a smartphone to film her reflection. (3) She moves to an entryway area as a man wearing a black tank top enters carrying several boxes and grocery bags; she interacts with him excitedly, pointing to her hair. (4) They transition to a seated position at a table where two clear plastic tubes containing hair ties are prominently displayed in the foreground. The man attempts to tie her hair into pigtails while she makes exaggerated facial expressions. (5) A montage of different hairstyles follows, including tiered pigtails and a high bun; the woman shakes her head vigorously to demonstrate the hair tie's grip while smiling and laughing. (6) Close-up macro shots show the woman stretching a beige woven hair tie with her hands to demonstrate its elasticity against a plain white background. (7) A sequence of product display shots features various colors and styles of hair ties—thick, thin, and fuzzy—spread out on a grey stone-textured surface. (8) The woman returns to the initial setting, speaking persuasively to the camera while holding several hair ties in her hands; promotional graphic overlays with yellow and white text appear on the screen.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-arousal female voice begins with an energetic and friendly tone over a bright, upbeat acoustic pop BGM featuring guitar and steady percussion. There is no noticeable background noise as she introduces the concept. (2) A sharp comedic sound effect (ding) triggers a phase where a male voice enters with a moderate conversational volume, accompanied by the physical sound of a door opening and plastic rustling from bags being set down. (3) The audio becomes more fragmented with frequent short edits of high-pitched female laughter, comedic 'spring' and 'pop' sound effects, and playful banter between the two voices. (4) The tone shifts to a professional and clear narrative style as the female voice enunciates product benefits; the music remains consistent, but rhythmic whoosh sound effects are layered to match the visual demonstration of stretching hair ties. (5) The final phase features high-density speech as the female speaker rapidly lists promotional offers and discount codes, ending with an enthusiastic sign-off over a slight crescendo in the BGM.
